title: THE BLOOD ORANGES OF SUNSPEAR // THE CYVASSE CYPHER
narrative: Prince Doran sat in his wheeled chair beneath the shade of blood orange trees in the Water Gardens, his gout-swollen joints wrapped in raw silk. On an ebony table lay an unfinished cyvasse board, its alabaster dragon piece resting upon a hidden ivory latch. Depressing the latch with his ring, Doran revealed a secret compartment holding a yellowed parchment written in Prince Rhaegar's own elegant hand: the secret betrothal contract between House Martell and the dragons, signed twenty-eight years ago, detailing the exact prophecy of the three heads.
